/// @title FP127 Production Contract
/// @notice Production contract for signed 127.128 fixed-point arithmetic
/// @dev Exposes both Fixed18 (WAD) and Raw interfaces for maximum flexibility

#include "constants.huff"
#include "primitives.huff"
#include "arithmetic.huff"
#include "log2.huff"
#include "exp.huff"
#include "ln.huff"
#include "sqrt.huff"
#include "pow.huff"
#include "utils.huff"
#include "transcendental_utils.huff"
#include "lambertw0.huff"

#define macro MAIN() = takes(0) returns(0) {
    // Read function selector
    0x00 calldataload 0xe0 shr
    
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(add) eq add_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(sub) eq sub_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(mul) eq mul_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(div) eq div_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(addRaw) eq add_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(subRaw) eq sub_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(mulRaw) eq mul_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(divRaw) eq div_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(fromFixed18) eq from_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(toFixed18) eq to_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(exp) eq exp_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(exp2) eq exp2_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(ln) eq ln_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(log2) eq log2_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(sqrt) eq sqrt_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(sqrtRaw) eq sqrt_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(expRaw) eq exp_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(exp2Raw) eq exp2_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(lnRaw) eq ln_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(log2Raw) eq log2_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(divUnsignedRaw) eq div_unsigned_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(pow) eq pow_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(powRaw) eq pow_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(abs) eq abs_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(neg) eq neg_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(inv) eq inv_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(min) eq min_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(max) eq max_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(clamp) eq clamp_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(avg) eq avg_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(zeroFloorSub) eq zeroFloorSub_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(dist) eq dist_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(gavg) eq gavg_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(log10) eq log10_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(exp10) eq exp10_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(absRaw) eq abs_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(negRaw) eq neg_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(invRaw) eq inv_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(minRaw) eq min_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(maxRaw) eq max_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(clampRaw) eq clamp_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(avgRaw) eq avg_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(zeroFloorSubRaw) eq zeroFloorSub_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(distRaw) eq dist_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(gavgRaw) eq gavg_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(log10Raw) eq log10_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(exp10Raw) eq exp10_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(sign) eq sign_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(floor) eq floor_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(ceil) eq ceil_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(frac) eq frac_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(cbrt) eq cbrt_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(lerp) eq lerp_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(hypot) eq hypot_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(signRaw) eq sign_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(floorRaw) eq floor_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(ceilRaw) eq ceil_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(fracRaw) eq frac_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(cbrtRaw) eq cbrt_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(lerpRaw) eq lerp_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(hypotRaw) eq hypot_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(round) eq round_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(log2Up) eq log2up_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(gcd) eq gcd_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(factorial) eq factorial_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(lambertW0) eq lambertw0_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(roundRaw) eq round_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(log2UpRaw) eq log2up_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(gcdRaw) eq gcd_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(factorialRaw) eq factorial_raw_jump jumpi
    dup1 __FUNC_SIG(lambertW0Raw) eq lambertw0_raw_jump jumpi

    // No match, revert
    0x00 0x00 revert
    
    add_jump:
        pop
        // Read two fixed18 args, convert, add, convert back
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fixed18, a_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_ADD()            // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    sub_jump:
        pop
        // Read two fixed18 args, convert, subtract, convert back
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fixed18, a_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_SUB()            // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    mul_jump:
        pop
        // Read two fixed18 args, convert, multiply, convert back
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fixed18, a_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_MUL()            // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    div_jump:
        pop
        // Read two fixed18 args, convert, divide, convert back
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fixed18, a_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_DIV()            // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    add_raw_jump:
        pop
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        add                    // [result_fp127]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    sub_raw_jump:
        pop
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        swap1 sub              // [result_fp127]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    mul_raw_jump:
        pop
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_MUL()            // [result_fp127]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    div_raw_jump:
        pop
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_DIV()            // [result_fp127]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    from_jump:
        pop
        // Convert fixed18 to fp127
        0x04 calldataload      // [fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [fp127]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    to_jump:
        pop
        // Convert fp127 to fixed18
        0x04 calldataload      // [fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    exp_jump:
        pop
        // Compute exp(x) with fixed18 I/O
        0x04 calldataload      // [x_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [x_fp127]
        FP127_EXP()            // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    exp2_jump:
        pop
        // Compute exp2(x) = 2^x with fixed18 I/O
        0x04 calldataload      // [x_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [x_fp127]
        FP127_EXP2()           // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    ln_jump:
        pop
        // Compute ln(x) with fixed18 I/O
        0x04 calldataload      // [x_fixed18]

        0x20 0x00 return
    
    log2_jump:
        pop

        0x00 mstore

    sqrt_jump:

        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [x_fp127]
        FP127_SQRT()           // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    sqrt_raw_jump:
        pop

        pop

        0x00 mstore

    ln_raw_jump:

    log2_raw_jump:

    exp2_raw_jump:
        pop

    div_unsigned_raw_jump:
        pop

        0x00 mstore

    pow_jump:
        pop

        0x24 calldataload      // [y_fixed18, x_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [y_fp127, x_fp127]

    abs_jump:
        pop
        // Compute abs(x) with fixed18 I/O
        0x04 calldataload      // [x_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [x_fp127]

        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [x_fp127]
        FP127_INV()            // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    min_jump:
        pop
        // Compute min(a, b) with fixed18 I/O
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fixed18, a_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_MIN()            // [result_fp127]
        FP127_TO_FIXED18()     // [result_fixed18]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return
    
    max_jump:
        pop
        // Compute max(a, b) with fixed18 I/O
        0x04 calldataload      // [a_fixed18]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fixed18, a_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [b_fp127, a_fp127]

    zeroFloorSub_jump:

        // Compute zeroFloorSub(a, b) with fixed18 I/O

        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [a_fp127]
        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fixed18, a_fp127]
        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [b_fp127, a_fp127]
        FP127_ZERO_FLOOR_SUB() // [result_fp127]

        0x24 calldataload      // [b_fp127, a_fp127]

        0x00 mstore

        FP127_LOG10()          // [result_fp127]
        0x00 mstore
        0x20 0x00 return

        0x04 calldataload      // [x_fp127]
        FP127_EXP10()          // [result_fp127]

        // Compute sign(x) with fixed18 I/O

        FP127_FROM_FIXED18()   // [x_fp127]
